justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/StructuralEvaluator.java, src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/QueryParser.java, and src/test/java/org/jsoup/select/SelectorTest.java. `Not` is a tiny nested evaluator with one constructor, one `evaluateMatch` override that only negates `memoMatches`, plus simple `cost`/`toString`; exact-reference search found only two repo hits: QueryParser creates it for `:not(...)` and SelectorTest instantiates it for a reset test. That is low fan-in and low fan-out, not a dependency hub.
